Future<String> call() async => 'ok';

// CASE dart_retry_backoff_multi expect=pass
Future<String> withRetry() async {
  for (var attempt = 0, delay = 200; attempt < 5; attempt++, delay *= 2) {
    try {
      return await call();
    } catch (_) {
      await Future<void>.delayed(Duration(milliseconds: delay));
    }
  }
  throw StateError('gave up');
}

// CASE dart_retry_backoff_single expect=pass
Future<String> withRetrySingle() async {
  var delay = 200;
  for (var attempt = 0; attempt < 5; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await call();
    } catch (_) {
      await Future<void>.delayed(Duration(milliseconds: delay));
      delay *= 2;
    }
  }
  throw StateError('gave up');
}
